tools.name: prepare_voice_demo_link
tools.description: Use when the user wants to try a free AI receptionist demo based on a public business website. Returns a link with the website prefilled. Does not fetch the site, start a voice call, send a message, create a phone number, or deploy an agent. The user builds and starts the demo in their browser.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "voice-demo" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_voice_demo_link · Public sink: prepare_voice_demo_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_voice_demo_link · Public sink: prepare_voice_demo_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
